title: Warm Flaky Argentinian Sushi Rice Empanadas
description: A malty and flaky solo dinner dish featuring sushi rice and coconut cream, inspired by Argentinian cuisine, this recipe is a unique fusion of flavors and textures, suitable for a raw friendly diet.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, malted milk powder, and salt.
Add the melted butter, egg, and sugar to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball of dough into a thin circle.
Place 1/2 cup of cooked sushi rice in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half moon shape and press the edges together to seal.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with coconut cream.
Bake the empanadas for 20 minutes or until golden brown.
